text:
clare (design): Quick micro-iteration: remove the persistent schema banner and replace it with a compact validation marker on each function row. the marker shows a count and opens a tiny inline inspector with short messages + jump links.
diego (devex): love the idea. prefer inline accordion under the row. keyboard: Enter toggles, Shift+Enter jump to first error, Esc closes.
mina (backend): backend note: re-run linter when opening but debounce 250ms and cache last good result for 30s. store a short summary for run-history only.
sylvie (a11y): make inspector role="region" aria-label="Function validation" and use aria-live="polite" when new errors appear. ensure focus moves into the panel and there's a clear close control.
clare (design): for run history, propose a compact run-card: tool name, one-line summary (first sentence), optional tiny cost chip (tokens / $) and chevron. expand reveals full structured output (tabs) and supports streaming with a live dot.
jon (product): cost chip is important for PMs. show tokens+USD when available; hide otherwise. rollout: 10% beta, track expand rate and avg cost per run; revert if avg cost delta >10%.
diego (devex): implementation: keep summaryText (<=256 chars), pointerId, costApprox, isStreaming, timestamp. lazy-load full payload on expand. UI should truncate at sentence boundary when possible and set focus to the output on expand.
mina (backend): I'll draft the RFC for pointer contract and add debounce + caching. pointing to internal object store.
preview-bot: clare uploaded preview: https://preview.redwood/playground/validation-marker-card
clare (design): action items: diego keyboard/focus doc, mina RFC + debounce, sylvie a11y checklist, jon experiment config. will attach final frames later. :sparkles:
